subject: Life Skills
title: The Power of Concessions
description: A short lesson to help you apply The Power of Concessions.

hook.text: A car buyer who negotiated three small concessions paid less than one who demanded a single large discount.

buildup.text: Concessions signal flexibility and build goodwill. Rigid positions create deadlock and resentment.

discovery.text: Strategic concessions are planned in advance. Give up things that matter little to you but much to them.

twist.text: Conceding too quickly signals desperation. Make each concession feel considered and proportional.

climax.text: Label your concessions: 'I can offer X, which is important to me, because I want us to reach agreement.'

punchline.text: Give what costs you little. Gain what matters most.

quiz.question: What is a strategic concession?
options: Giving up on your most important demand
Giving something that costs you little but matters to them
Refusing to budge until the other party concedes first
